name: agent-readiness-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the agent-readiness Hugo module, run against the published files that five hugo builds produce: the fixture with every content-license key unset, the same fixture with them set, a minimal build configuring almost nothing (the shape a consumer gets on import), a build with the twins switched off site-wide while the markdown format stays wired, and a shadowing fixture that ships its own layouts/robots.txt. The module ships zero JavaScript, so there is no browser behavior to test.
